name: Mads Christiansen
bio:
Mads' journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly. Originally studying journalism, a chance internship with a local racing team ignited a passion for the sport that quickly eclipsed his initial career aspirations. He quickly showed a knack for spinning technical jargon into compelling narratives, a skill he honed through years of freelancing for various motorsports publications.

Before joining Porsche Penske Motorsport, Mads worked with smaller teams, gaining invaluable experience managing both internal and external communications. His pragmatic approach to PR focuses on building authentic relationships with media and fans alike. He believes in honesty and transparency, even when delivering difficult news, which has earned him a reputation for integrity within the paddock.

Mads is uniquely skilled in understanding the technical aspects of racing, allowing him to translate complex engineering innovations into accessible and engaging stories. He strives to not only promote the team's successes but also to foster a deeper appreciation for the science and dedication that drive motorsport forward.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Mads is of average height with a sturdy build, often seen sporting a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with potential PR angles and quotes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on brewing his own coffee, claiming it's crucial for clear thinking.
